title: Understanding the Plots
text: Look at how the mean squared error (MSE) changes with the degree of the polynomial. Consider how training and validation errors typically behave as model complexity increases.

title: Training vs. Validation Error
text: Remember that training error usually decreases as model complexity increases, while validation error decreases up to a point and then increases due to overfitting.

title: Identifying the Correct Plot
text: Which plot shows a decrease in training error with increasing polynomial degree, while validation error decreases and then increases?
